EXTRAORDINARYThe Gazette of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
FILLING OF A VACANCY IN THE OFFICE OF MEMBER OF THE MIRIGAMA PRADESHIYASABHA UNDER SECTION 66A(1) OF THE LOCAL AUTHORITIES ELECTIONS ORDINANCE(CHAPTER 262)
WHEREAS the office of member of Mirigama Pradeshiya Sabha has fallen vacant by reason of Resigning ;

AND WHEREAS the Secretary of the Sri Lanka Freedom Party, the recognized political party to whichHewasinhage Nalin Pushpakumara Hewasinghe the member belonged, was required by me under section 66A(1) of theaforesaid ordinance, to decide upon returned member of Sri Lanka Freedom Party who belongs to such party and is notdisqualified under Section 9 of the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance and who shall be declared selected as amember within a period of thirty (30) days ;
AND WHEREAS the Secretary of the aforesaid recognized Political Party, has communicated his decision tonominate Hettiarachchige Santha Geethadeva to fill such vacancy ;

NOW THEREFORE I, Karunasingha Jayarathnage Sampath Madhawa, Returning Officer of the MirigamaPradeshiya Sabha, acting in terms of Section 66A(1) of the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance (Chapter 262) dohereby declare that Hettiarachchige Santha Geethadeva was selected as the member of the Mirigama Pradeshiya Sabha.
K. J. S. MADHAWA,Returning Officer,Mirigama Pradeshiya Sabha.
